40019904.author: पदार्थः
40019904.content: अथ then, पुत्रः the son, पुलस्त्यस्य of Pulastya, विश्रवाः Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, अचिरेण एव in a short time, कालेन by time, पिता इव like his father, तपसि in penance, स्थितः engaged.

40019904.author: Translation
40019904.content: Then, Vishrava, the son of Pulastya and foremost among sages, soon became engaged in penance just like his father.

40019905.author: पदार्थः
40019905.content: सत्यवान् truthful, शीलवान् virtuous, शान्तः peaceful, स्वाध्यायनिरतः devoted to self-study, शुचिः pure, सर्वभोगेषु in all enjoyments, असंसक्तः unattached, नित्यम् always, धर्मपरायणः devoted to righteousness.

40019905.author: Translation
40019905.content: He was truthful, virtuous, peaceful, devoted to Vedic study, pure, unattached to all worldly enjoyments, and constantly dedicated to righteousness.

40019906.author: पदार्थः
40019906.content: ज्ञात्वा having known, तस्य his, तु indeed, तत् वृत्तम् that conduct, भरद्वाजः Bharadvaja, महामुनिः the great sage, ददौ gave, विश्रवसे to Vishrava, भार्याम् a wife, स्वसुताम् his own daughter, देववर्णिनीम् Devavarnini.

40019906.author: Translation
40019906.content: Understanding Vishrava's excellent character, the great sage Bharadvaja gave his own daughter, Devavarnini, as a wife to Vishrava.

40019907.author: पदार्थः
40019907.content: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, तु indeed, धर्मेण righteously, भरद्वाजसुताम् Bharadvaja's daughter, तदा then, प्रजान्वेक्षिकया with a mind intent on progeny, बुद्ध्या with understanding, श्रेयः the welfare, हि indeed, अस्य his, विचिन्तयन् contemplating.

40019907.author: Translation
40019907.content: Then, Vishrava, having righteously accepted Bharadvaja's daughter, contemplated his welfare with an intellect focused on the desire for progeny.

40019908.author: पदार्थः
40019908.content: मुदा with joy, परमया supreme, युक्तो endowed, विश्रवा Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः foremost among sages, स he, तस्यां in her, वीर्यसम्पन्नम् endowed with valor, अपत्यं an offspring, परमाद्भुतम् exceedingly wonderful

40019908.author: Translation
40019908.content: The foremost sage Vishrava, filled with supreme joy, begot in her an exceedingly wonderful offspring endowed with great valor.

40019909.author: पदार्थः
40019909.content: जनयामास begot, धर्मज्ञः the knower of Dharma, सर्वैर्ब्रह्मगुणैर्युतम् endowed with all divine qualities, तस्मिञ्जाते when he was born, तु indeed, संहृष्टः greatly delighted, सम्बभूव became, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma)

40019909.author: Translation
40019909.content: This knower of Dharma begot a child endowed with all divine qualities, and when he was born, the grandfather (Brahma) became greatly delighted.

40019910.author: पदार्थः
40019910.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रेयस्करीं auspicious, बुद्धिं intention, धनाध्यक्षो lord of wealth, भविष्यति will be, नाम a name, तस्याकरोत् he made for him, प्रीतः pleased, सार्धं together with, देवर्षिभिस्तदा the divine sages then

40019910.author: Translation
40019910.content: Having perceived his auspicious intention to become the lord of wealth, the pleased grandfather (Brahma), together with the divine sages, then gave him a name.

40019911.author: पदार्थः
40019911.content: यस्मात् because, विश्रवसो of Vishrava, अपत्यं the offspring, सादृश्यात् due to resemblance, विश्रवा Vishrava, इव like, तस्मात् therefore, वैश्रवणो Vaishravana, नाम by name, भविष्यत्वेष this one will be, विश्रुतः renowned

40019911.author: Translation
40019911.content: Because this offspring of Vishrava resembles Vishrava himself, he will therefore be renowned by the name Vaishravana.

40019912.author: पदार्थः
40019912.content: स he, तु indeed, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, तत्र there, तपोवनगतः having gone to the hermitage, तदा then, अवर्धत grew, आहुतिहुतो nourished by oblations, महातेजा greatly effulgent, यथा like, अनलः fire

40019912.author: Translation
40019912.content: Then, Vaishravana, having gone to the hermitage, grew there, greatly effulgent, like a fire nourished by oblations.

40019913.author: पदार्थः
40019913.content: तस्याश्रमपदस्थस्य residing in his hermitage, बुद्धिः thought, जज्ञे arose, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, चरिष्ये I shall practice, परमम् supreme, धर्मम् righteousness, धर्मः righteousness, हि indeed, परमा supreme, गतिः goal.

40019913.author: Translation
40019913.content: A thought arose in the mind of the great sage residing in his hermitage that he would practice supreme righteousness, for righteousness is indeed the ultimate goal.

40019914.author: पदार्थः
40019914.content: सः he, तु indeed, वर्षसहस्राणि for thousands of years, तपः penance, तप्त्वा having performed, महावने in the great forest, यन्त्रितः restrained, नियमैः by vows, उग्रैः severe, चकार performed, सुमहत्तपः very great penance.

40019914.author: Translation
40019914.content: Indeed, he performed very great penance for thousands of years in the great forest, having restrained himself with severe vows.

40019915.author: पदार्थः
40019915.content: पूर्णे at the completion, वर्षसहस्रान्ते of a thousand years, तम् तम् various, विधिम् methods, अकल्पयत् he adopted, जलाशी subsisting on water, मारुताहारः subsisting on air, निराहारः without food, तथैव च and similarly.

40019915.author: Translation
40019915.content: At the completion of each thousand years, he adopted various methods of austerity, such as subsisting only on water, then only on air, and then completely without food.

40019916.author: पदार्थः
40019916.content: एवम् thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, जग्मुः passed, तानि those, एकवर्षवत् like a single year, अथ then, प्रीतः pleased, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, सेन्द्रैः with Indra, सुरगणैः with the hosts of gods, सह together.

40019916.author: Translation
40019916.content: Thus, those thousands of years passed as if they were a single year, and then the greatly effulgent Brahma, pleased, came with Indra and the hosts of gods.

40019917.author: पदार्थः
40019917.content: गत्वा having gone, तस्य his, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, ब्रह्मा Brahma, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke, परितुष्टः greatly pleased, अस्मि I am, ते with you, वत्स O child, कर्मणा by deed, अनेन this, सुव्रत O one of good vows, वरम् boon, वृणीष्व choose, भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, वरार्हः deserving of a boon, त्वम् you, महामते O great-minded one.

40019917.author: Translation
40019917.content: Having gone to his hermitage, Brahma spoke these words: "O child of good vows, I am greatly pleased with this deed of yours; choose a boon, may there be welfare for you, O great-minded one, for you are deserving of a boon."

40019918.author: पदार्थः
40019918.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, पितामहम् to the grandfather (Brahma), उपस्थितम् who was present, भगवन् O Lord, लोकपालत्वम् the state of being a world-protector, इच्छेयम् I desire, वित्तरक्षणम् the protection of wealth,

40019918.author: Translation
40019918.content: Then Vaishravana, standing before his grandfather Brahma, said, "O Lord, I desire to be a guardian of the world and a protector of wealth."

40019919.author: पदार्थः
40019919.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, वैश्रवणम् to Vaishravana, परितुष्टेन with a very pleased, चेतसा mind, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरगणैः with the hosts of gods, सार्धम् together with, बाढम् "So be it", इति thus, एव indeed, हृष्टवत् joyfully,

40019919.author: Translation
40019919.content: Then Brahma, with a very pleased mind, joyfully spoke to Vaishravana in the presence of the hosts of gods, saying, "So be it."

40019920.author: पदार्थः
40019920.content: अहम् I, वै indeed, लोकपालानाम् among the world-protectors, चतुर्थम् the fourth, स्रष्टुम् to create, उद्यतः was ready,

40019920.author: Translation
40019920.content: Brahma declared, "Indeed, I was about to create the fourth among the world-protectors."

40019921.author: पदार्थः
40019921.content: यम Yama, इन्द्र Indra, वरुणानाम् and Varuna, च and, पदम् the position, यत् which, तव by you, च and, ईप्सितम् desired, तत् that, गच्छ attain, त्वम् you, हि indeed, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, निधीशत्वम् the state of being the lord of treasures, अवाप्नुहि obtain, शक्र Indra, अम्बुप Varuna, यमानाम् and Yama, च and, चतुर्थः the fourth, त्वम् you, भविष्यसि will be,

40019921.author: Translation
40019921.content: Brahma continued, "O righteous one, attain that desired position alongside Yama, Indra, and Varuna; indeed, obtain the lordship of treasures, and you shall be the fourth among Indra, Varuna, and Yama."

40019922.author: पदार्थः
40019922.content: एतत् this, च and, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, नाम named, विमानम् aerial chariot, सूर्यसन्निभम् resembling the sun, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व accept, यानार्थम् for the purpose of travel, त्रिदशैः with the gods, समताम् equality, व्रज attain,

40019922.author: Translation
40019922.content: "And accept this aerial chariot named Pushpaka, which resembles the sun, for your travels, and thereby attain equality with the gods."

40019923.author: पदार्थः
40019923.content: स्वस्ति well-being, ते to you, अस्तु let there be, गमिष्यामः we shall go, सर्व all, एव indeed, यथागतम् as we came, कृतकृत्याः having accomplished our purpose, वयम् we, तात dear son, दत्त्वा having given, तव your, वरद्वयम् two boons.

40019923.author: Translation
40019923.content: Brahma declared that they had accomplished their purpose by granting two boons and would now depart as they had arrived, wishing well-being upon the recipient.

40019924.author: पदार्थः
40019924.content: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, सः he, गतः went, ब्रह्मा Brahma, स्वस्थानम् to his own abode, त्रिदशैः with the gods, सह together with.

40019924.author: Translation
40019924.content: Having spoken thus, Brahma returned to his own abode accompanied by the gods.

40019925.author: पदार्थः
40019925.content: गतेषु when they had gone, ब्रह्मपूर्वेषु led by Brahma, देवेषु the gods, अथ then, नभस्थलम् to the sky, वने in the forest, सः he, पितरम् to his father, प्राह said, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रयतात्मवान् with a controlled mind, निवासनम् a dwelling place, न not, मे for me, देवः the god, विदधे provided, सः that, प्रजापतिः lord of creatures.

40019925.author: Translation
40019925.content: After Brahma and the other gods departed to the heavens, Ravana, with folded hands and a controlled mind, addressed his father in the forest, stating that Brahma had not provided him with a dwelling place.

40019926.author: पदार्थः
40019926.content: भगवन् O revered one, लब्धवान् I have obtained, अस्मि I am, वरम् a boon, इष्टम् desired, पितामहात् from the grandfather, तम् that, पश्य find, भगवन् O revered one, कञ्चित् some, निवासम् dwelling place, साधु suitable, मे for me, प्रभो O lord.

40019926.author: Translation
40019926.content: Ravana informed his father that he had received his desired boon from Brahma and requested his father to find a suitable dwelling place for him.

40019927.author: पदार्थः
40019927.content: न not, च and, पीडा harm, भवेत् should be, यत्र where, प्राणिनः of a living being, यस्य कस्यचित् of any whatsoever, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, पुत्रेण by his son, विश्रवाः Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.

40019927.author: Translation
40019927.content: Ravana further specified that the dwelling place should be one where no living being would suffer any harm, and upon hearing this request from his son, Vishrava, the foremost among sages, considered it.

40019928.author: पदार्थः
40019928.content: वचनं word, प्राह said, धर्मज्ञः the knower of dharma, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, इति thus, सत्तमः the excellent one. दक्षिणस्य of the southern, उदधेः of the ocean, तीरे on the shore, त्रिकूटो Trikuta, नाम named, पर्वतः mountain.

40019928.author: Translation
40019928.content: The righteous and excellent one spoke, saying, "Listen! On the shore of the southern ocean, there is a mountain named Trikuta."

40019929.author: पदार्थः
40019929.content: तस्य of that (mountain), अग्रे on the top, तु indeed, विशाला vast, सा that, महेन्द्रस्य of Mahendra, पुरी city, यथा like. लङ्का Lanka, नाम named, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, निर्मिता built, विश्वकर्मणा by Vishwakarma.

40019929.author: Translation
40019929.content: On the top of that mountain, there is a vast and beautiful city named Lanka, constructed by Vishwakarma, resembling the city of Mahendra (Indra).

40019930.author: पदार्थः
40019930.content: राक्षसानां of the Rakshasas, निवासार्थं for residence, यथा just as, इन्द्रस्य of Indra, अमरावती Amaravati. तत्र there, त्वं you, वस dwell, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, लङ्कायां in Lanka, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.

40019930.author: Translation
40019930.content: That city is meant for the residence of Rakshasas, just as Amaravati is for Indra; you should dwell there in Lanka, and there is no doubt that it will bring you good fortune.

40019931.author: पदार्थः
40019931.content: हेमप्राकारपरिघा having golden ramparts and moats, यन्त्रशस्त्रसमावृता equipped with machines and weapons. रमणीया charming, पुरी city, सा that, हि indeed, रुक्म gold, वैडूर्य lapis lazuli, तोरणा having archways.

40019931.author: Translation
40019931.content: That delightful city is indeed equipped with golden ramparts and moats, fortified with machines and weapons, and adorned with archways made of gold and lapis lazuli.

40019932.author: पदार्थः
40019932.content: राक्षसैः by the Rakshasas, सा that (city), परित्यक्ता abandoned, पुरा formerly, विष्णुभयार्दितैः afflicted by fear of Vishnu. शून्या empty, रक्षोगणैः by the hordes of Rakshasas, सर्वैः all, रसातलतलं to the nethermost region, गतैः having gone.

40019932.author: Translation
40019932.content: That city was formerly abandoned by all the hordes of Rakshasas, who, afflicted by fear of Vishnu, had gone to the nethermost regions, leaving it deserted.

40019933.author: पदार्थः
40019933.content: शून्या empty, सम्प्रति now, लङ्का Lanka, सा that, प्रभुः lord, तस्याः of it, न not, विद्यते exists, सः therefore, त्वम् you, तत्र there, निवासाय for dwelling, गच्छ go, पुत्र son, यथासुखम् comfortably.

40019933.author: Translation
40019933.content: That Lanka is now empty and without a master, so you, my son, should go and reside there comfortably.

40019934.author: पदार्थः
40019934.content: निर्दोषः faultless, तत्र there, ते your, वासः dwelling, न not, बाधाः obstacles, तत्र there, कस्यचित् of anyone, एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, सः he, धर्मात्मा righteous soul, धर्मिष्ठम् most righteous, वचनम् word, पितुः of the father.

40019934.author: Translation
40019934.content: Your dwelling there will be without hindrance, and there will be no obstacles from anyone; having heard this most righteous command from his father, that righteous soul (Kubera)...

40019935.author: पदार्थः
40019935.content: निवासयामास caused to dwell, तदा then, लङ्काम् Lanka, पर्वतमूर्धनि on the mountain top, नैर्ऋतानाम् of the Rakshasas, सहस्रैः with thousands, तु indeed, हृष्टैः delighted, प्रमुदुतैः greatly joyful, सह with.

40019935.author: Translation
40019935.content: ...then settled Lanka, situated on the mountain top, with thousands of delighted and greatly joyful Rakshasas.

40019936.author: पदार्थः
40019936.content: अचिरेण in a short, एव indeed, कालेन time, सम्पूर्णा filled, तस्य his, शासनात् by command.

40019936.author: Translation
40019936.content: In a very short time, Lanka was completely filled by his command.

40019937.author: पदार्थः
40019937.content: सः he, तु indeed, तत्र there, अवसत् dwelt, प्रीतः pleased, धर्मात्मा righteous soul, नैर्ऋतर्षभः chief of Rakshasas, समुद्रपरिघायाम् surrounded by the ocean, तु indeed, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, विश्रवात्मजः son of Vishrava.

40019937.author: Translation
40019937.content: That righteous soul, the chief of Rakshasas and son of Vishrava (Kubera), happily dwelt there in Lanka, which was surrounded by the ocean.

40019938.author: पदार्थः
40019938.content: काले काले from time to time, तु indeed, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, पुष्पकेण by Pushpaka, धनेश्वरः lord of wealth, अभ्यागच्छत् used to come, विनीतात्मा humble-souled, पितरं father, मातरं mother, च and, हि indeed.

40019938.author: Translation
40019938.content: The righteous and humble Kubera, the lord of wealth, used to visit his father and mother from time to time in his Pushpaka chariot.

40019939.author: पदार्थः
40019939.content: सः he, देवगन्धर्वगणैः by hosts of gods and gandharvas, अभिष्टुतः praised, तथा and, अप्सरोनृत्यविभूषितालयः whose abode was adorned by the dances of Apsaras, गभस्तिभिः by rays, सूर्यः sun, इव like, अवभासयन् illuminating, पितुः father's, समीपं proximity, प्रययौ went, सः he, वित्तपः lord of wealth.

40019939.author: Translation
40019939.content: Praised by hosts of gods and Gandharvas, and with his abode adorned by the dances of Apsaras, that lord of wealth, Kubera, approached his father, shining like the sun with its rays. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे तृतीयः सर्गः ।। 3 ।। Thus ends the third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
